content:
“Chems don't grow on trees. Or do they?”

**Pharma Farma** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

A chance to increase amount of chems found based on Luck. The chance is also based on Luck.

| Luck | Trigger Chance | 
| 1 ≤ LCK < 15 | 20% | 
| 15 ≤ LCK < 30 | 40% | 
| 30 ≤ LCK < 60 | 60% | 
| 60 ≤ LCK ≤ 100 | 85% | 

| ![FO76 pharma farma perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/d/de/FO76_pharma_farma_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Luck | Chems Multiplier | 
| | 1 | 2 | 
| | 15 | 2.75 | 
| | 30 | 3.2 | 
| | 60 | 3.65 | 
| | 100 | 4 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Find more first aid Chems based on your LCK. | 0034EBCA | 

- A card is found in Vault 76 on checkpoint pop-up number 6, labeled "Get a Job."
- Affected chems include:

- Before update 58, the perk had 3 ranks that provided 40%/60%/80% chance to find extra first aid chems after a chem container search.
